alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 7 at 10:30AM PDT until September 10 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures 97 to 102 and low temperatures 65 to 75
expected, with widespread Moderate HeatRisk and areas of Major
HeatRisk.

* WHERE...The central and southern Sacramento Valley, northern San
Joaquin Valley, Delta and Carquinez Strait, Foothills, and portions
of the Coast Range.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Wednesday to 10 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses, especially to
anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.

* ADDITIONAL DETAIL
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 8 at 12:09AM PDT until September 10 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot late-season conditions expected with high
temperatures up to 112 to 116 in Death Valley and the Colorado
River Valley; up to 105 to 110 in the Las Vegas Valley, Moapa
Valley, and Pahrump Valley.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest Arizona, southeast California, and
southern Nevada.

* WHEN...From 10 AM PDT / MST to 8 PM PDT / MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat-related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat.
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
